answer: An answer must include the first 21 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the raven derivation is checked against the karst nonce, the gale audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 87 aliases produces 87 mismatches and burns the authoring cost with no payout. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
